verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents opening custom ports through docker -p options (docs-52), automatically creates Cloudflare tunnels for each open port (docs-49), and lets you filter offers by direct port count (docs-20), which covers serving applications. It also documents overlay networks that give instances a private virtual LAN (docs-12/18), but only for instances on machines that share the same physical LAN. Missing for 10: private networking across different hosts or locations, deeper docs on overlay network setup and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of port exposure and overlay networking.
